name: [v1.7.0] The Hotkey & Transparency Update!
body: ### This update finally adds global hotkeys for custom goals, allows overlay transparency + new fading animations and so, so much more! > Watch the Devlog [here](https://youtu.be/olu31QBKuT4). ----- ## Global Hotkeys - NEW OS-level **global hotkeys** for an custom goal firing while ingame. - Hotkeys accept any combinations with Ctrl (or Cmd)/Alt (or Option)/Shift as well. ## Advancely Shortcuts - Fully decorated the `Hotkeys` tab, with many new in-app hotkeys/hotkey combinations. - Added 10 pixel movement to selected items in the Visual Layout Editor as well - Template Editor hotkeys blocked while a coop lobby is active. - Custom goal keys no longer collide with Layout Editor keys. ## Overlay - The overlay now allows for **transparent background** instead of the singular color. (Requires the enabling of `Allow Transparency` in the Game Capture properties inside OBS.) - Added optional fade-out for Belt/Page rows, compact stack and row 1 of all modes. - Mainly for Linux Waywall setups, proper support for running the overlay as a separate process (--overlay) was added, so the overlay never opens twice and has to be restarted manually on settings change (new warnings). - Also added an error message when overlay is trying to be summoned as a separate process, but Advancely itself is not yet running. - Added new option to stat categories (with substats) in the Template Editor to hide sub-stats from the first row, but not from the cycling text. With this the `_categorical` templates have received a cleanup. ## Performance - Fixed Advancely rendering ~2x slower while Minecraft was running. - Moved the Active-instance check off the main thread. - **Fixed the Window auto-detect world-change flip-flopping.** This is a massive performance improvement and allows the usage of Counter hotkeys and the Visual Layout Editor when the game is not running. - Added new `--profiler` flag to debug frame rendering times into it's own log. More info [here](https://github.com/LNXSeus/Advancely#command-line-arguments). ## Timing - Advancely now reads `final_igt` from SpeedRunsIGT's `record.json` during a run to provide a more accurate IGT value and freezes on the time when the game gets paused after the run completion. This is still I bug currently. When SpeedrunIGT is available it will freeze on the IGT time instead if it lines up with the template completion, will be part of the next release. - The new "Freeze Timer on Completion" is now on by default. ## Visual Layout Editor (VLE) - The VLE now allows copying and deleting **live** without having to save first. - By holding two movement keys (e.g., W and D or Down and Left arrow) diagonal movement is now possible within the VLE. - Right-clicking a goal in the VLE just selects it in the Template Editor without putting a selection outline. - Fixed tooltip positioning to solely rely on where the mouse is hovering. - Copies are now also properly selected after copying (Ctrl/Cmd+C by default). ## Main Tracker Window - Compacted all of the camera options into one `View` button, that now houses a precise zoom slider and also the option to `Lock Camera` to not accidentally pan. - All `Lock Layout`, `Lock Camera` and `Manual Layout` options are now hooked up to their own individual hotkeys (see screenshot above). ## Manual Positioning / Hiding - Independently positioned sub-items now ignore parent hiding. **This could break some of your templates, if sub-items/-text gets hidden and you're confused, just join the [Advancely Discord Server](https://discord.gg/TyNgXDz) and read [this message](https://discord.com/channels/753015751115276299/1422228975207452823/1541488944951066804) for instructions.** - Enabling manual position stats at the item's actual screen position. - Automatic goals arrange properly. - All templates updated to match that. ## Template Editor - Custom goals, unlocks and decorations now use the standard list + details pane to match the existing layout of all the other goal types. - To accommodate for the change above, the decorations now have the compacted "Add..." buttons. - A "Select All" bulk action was added for all goal types. - Properly added tooltips on all bulk-action popups. - New stat-category search tags got added (also to the main tracker search bar): `multi`, `multistat`, `nor1`, ... ## Packaging/Updater - macOS + non-portable Linux installs now seed fonts, GUI, reference files and icons into the user writable data dir. - macOS' seeding is gated on a version stamp, to only copy new files over on a new update. - Added a new "What's New?" button to the update popup to see these release notes before updating. - Improved naming on the updating popup's buttons. - Fixed the `--updated` flag showing nothing when the internal update URL file was missing or empty. It now falls back to the current version's release page and always opens the release notes popup. - Added a new `--update` flag to trigger the updater popup in the first place. ## Templates - All `_categorical` templates got updated (massive shoutout to [ScrambledMC](https://www.twitch.tv/scrambledmc)) and 4 new ones got added (1.20, 1.20.5, 1.21, 1.21.6). - Added a new frog gif file and 3D wither model required for the new updated `_categorical` templates. - Shortened 1.16 egap stage naming and fixed 1.12 lapis lazuli stat. ## Fixes - Stages are no longer briefly forgotten on a failed file read resulting in the compact stack treating it as a new completion repeatedly. - Fixed (global) hotkeys still being consumed after template switch. - Editor Hotkey also only closes the editor when the X button would also allow it. - SPACE (default) now doesn't toggle the `Lock Layout` when a window is focused. - Fixed macOS Command firing as Ctrl and thus not working. - Pasted room codes automatically trim spaces (done by @The64thRealm). - Also added hotkey collisions errors showing globally at the very top of the settings instead of only within the individual collapsing sections. ----- > Find more info on the [tracker main page](https://github.com/LNXSeus/Advancely)! ----- ## *[Donations](https://streamlabs.com/lnxseus/tip) are always welcome\! Make sure to mention `Advancely` in the donation message.* Enjoy the update\!
